elnsmwadapterui: Generic name for the ELN SMW Adapter extension, not tied to any specific ELN system
elnsmwadapterui-form-url-help: Generic help text that works for any ELN system with structured experiment data
elnsmwadapterui-option-url-import: Generic option for URL-based import from any supported system
elnsmwadapterui-form-file-help: Help text above the file upload form. Mentions that the file can also be dropped onto the file selection button (drag and drop), not tied to specific file formats
elnsmwadapterui-error:
Unused at this time.

Used as error message.
elnsmwadapterui-form-url-placeholder: Placeholder example of an experiment URL in the URL input field
elnsmwadapterui-form-select-placeholder: First, unselectable option of a select field reported by the adapter service
elnsmwadapterui-option-upload:
Option in the import method dropdown for a file upload plugin.

Parameters:
* $1 - name of the plugin
elnsmwadapterui-status-connected:
Service status line shown when the adapter service is reachable.

Parameters:
* $1 - version of the service
elnsmwadapterui-status-smw-connection:
Service status line about the Semantic MediaWiki connection.

Parameters:
* $1 - connection state reported by the service
elnsmwadapterui-status-plugins:
Service status line listing the enabled plugins.

Parameters:
* $1 - comma-separated plugin names
elnsmwadapterui-status-disconnected: Service status shown when the adapter service cannot be reached
elnsmwadapterui-error-no-file: Error shown when the upload form was submitted without a file
elnsmwadapterui-error-upload-dir: Error shown when the service did not report an upload directory
elnsmwadapterui-error-remove-existing: Error shown when a previously uploaded file with the same name cannot be deleted
elnsmwadapterui-error-save-upload: Error shown when the uploaded file cannot be moved to the upload directory
elnsmwadapterui-error-unknown-method:
Error shown for an unknown import method.

Parameters:
* $1 - the requested method
elnsmwadapterui-error-no-results: Error shown when the results page is opened without result data
elnsmwadapterui-error-no-job-id: Error shown when the processing page is opened without a job ID
elnsmwadapterui-processing-title: Page title while an import job is running
elnsmwadapterui-processing-status: Status text shown next to the progress bar while an import job is running
elnsmwadapterui-processing-timeout: Error shown when polling the job status gave up after 3 minutes
elnsmwadapterui-processing-failed:
Error shown when the import job failed.

Parameters:
* $1 - error reported by the service
elnsmwadapterui-processing-failed-unknow: Error shown when the import job failed without an error message
elnsmwadapterui-results-no-log: Text shown on the results page when the import produced no log messages
elnsmwadapterui-form-legend: Legend of the framed URL import form, generic for any supported ELN system
elnsmwadapterui-form-select-legend: Legend of the framed form for choosing the import method
elnsmwadapterui-form-upload-legend: Legend of the framed file upload form
